mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfers ( trip_id, from_member_id, to_member_id, amount, memo ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{fromMemberId}, #{toMemberId}, #{amount}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.from_member_id AS fromMemberId, fm.display_name AS fromMemberName, t.to_member_id AS toMemberId, tm.display_name AS toMemberName, t.amount, t.memo, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM transfers t JOIN trip_members fm ON fm.id = t.from_member_id JOIN trip_members tm ON tm.id = t.to_member_id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
